main_text.head: SECT. VII.
Hæresis Romana de Iustificatione.
main_text.p: De vera pacific. contr. Interim.Augustum quidem est (si-quod aliud) Iustificatio-nis caput, vt coactus fuerit o-lim Caluinus operosè inculca-re, vno hoc saluo, precium o-peræ fore de reliquis pertina-cius litigare. Vtinam obtine-ret illud Cassandri; cuius hæc sunt : Quod dicitur homines non posse iustificari coram Deo, proprijs viribus, meritis aut operibus, sed gratis iustifi-cari per fidem, semper in Ec-clesia probatum, & retentum fuit, & hodie quoq; ab omni-Consultat. De Iustificat.bus
Text at the lower edge: "bus" completes the last line.

page.notes: The first letter "A" of "Augustum" is a large woodcut initial; the word as printed reads "Augustum" with the initial A. Marginal notes on the right are small italic and are transcribed in place. Faint show-through text from the reverse side is ignored. The word "Augustum" may be a printing error for "Augustinum"; left as printed. Some faint lines at the bottom right are illegible.
